description: This file defines a singly linked list implementation, including methods for adding, removing, retrieving size, and accessing elements by index.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A class implementing a singly linked list data structure with basic operations.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Inner class representing a node in the linked list, holding data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Unlinks a node from the list, updating references accordingly.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Helper function to get the last node in the list starting from head.
